claim_text: Through our recycling and reuse initiatives, we were able to meet 39% of our overall demand, while water extraction at KGP remained well below the licensed annual entitlement.
metric_name: Total water use; Reused water; Recycled water; withdrawn water
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The report states that recycling and reuse initiatives met 39% of overall water demand, while the disclosed KGP total withdrawn water of 3,563 ML remained below the approved annual entitlement of 5,000 ML.
llm_reason: The claim has two decisive assertions: (1) recycling and reuse initiatives met 39% of overall demand, and (2) water extraction at KGP remained well below the licensed annual entitlement. The evidence substantiates the second assertion: KGP total withdrawn water is 3,563 ML versus an annual entitlement of 4,000–5,000 ML, which is below the entitlement range. However, the evidence does not substantiate the 39% figure for meeting overall demand through recycling and reuse: it provides recycled water (20 ML) and reused water (2,259 ML) but does not provide the ‘overall demand’ denominator or any calculation showing these volumes equal 39% of demand.
